        break

if bob_message is None:
    raise ValueError("No message found from Bob in the 'general' channel.")

# Use AI to extract the article URL from Bob's message
class ArticleLink(BaseModel):
    url: str

    article_info = query_ai_assistant(
        f"Extract the URL of the article mentioned in the following message: {bob_message.body}",
        ArticleLink

    article_url = article_info.url
except NotEnoughInformationError:
    raise ValueError("Could not find an article URL in Bob's message.")

# Fetch the content of the article
article_content = get_webpage(article_url)

if article_content is None:
    raise ValueError("Failed to retrieve the article content.")

# Summarize the article using the AI assistant
class Summary(BaseModel):
    summary: str

summary_info = query_ai_assistant(
    f"Summarize the following article content:\n\n{article_content}",
    Summary
)

# Send the summary to Alice
send_direct_message('Alice', summary_info.summary)
